latest_release.name: v7.1.2
latest_release.body:
New in v7.1-7.1.2:

Supporter badges: larger files, available for longer.

SimpleX public names: sale starts on December 12.

Safer channels: add moderators and sign every message.

Flat layout and markdown: enable in Appearance settings.

Get your badge: https://simplex.chat/badges/
Read more about SimpleX public names: https://simplex.domains

Commits:
- desktop: show macOS notifications via Notification Center (#7879)
- core: apply member role and files setting to every received group file (#7899)
- ui: references of the flat layout names, italic, paragraphs and what's new (#8034)
- desktop: a profile created when no profile exists shows its picture as bio text and loses the typed bio (#7960)
- android, desktop: a report stays active in an open support chat after its message is moderated (#7908)
- core, ui: report reason with rule text, ios gaps as in plain text (#8035)
- website: channel pages show every empty line of a message (#8028)
- core: prevent chunks of completed or cancelled inline files (#8042)
- directory, support bot: bold texts use double stars (#8040)
- blog: correct the date of the 5-year name perk (#8045)
- core: list received file servers only from a complete description (#8047)
- core: 7.1.0.20 (#8046)
- ios: update WebRTC to M156 (#7878)
- libs: nodejs 7.1.0-beta.10.2 (#8048)
- core: ignore introductions of own member and from non-announcing members (#7874)
- mcp server: files, /leave and library methods (#7962)
- core: keep forwarded messages in order when a batch is full (#8058)
- ios: clamp voice and video durations (#8056)
- android: limit source and decoded image dimensions (#8063)
- desktop: show the preview when a received image cannot be decoded (#8062)
- ios: v7.1.1 (#8067)
- core: 7.1.2.0 (simplexmq 7.1.0.17)
- ios: free call media frame buffers, drop frames that fail crypto (#8065)
- ios: fix video in calls between updated apps and freezing on hang-up (#7983)
- ci: publish the MCP server from build.yml (#8049)
- ios: send no audio from senders without a track (#8069)
- 7.1.2: android 393, desktop 173, ios 369
